text: Every morning, a nurse takes over the ward from the night shift. And very often, the handover note ends like this: quiet night, nil else.
Relayd reads every shift's notes, not just last night's, and shows what they left out. Let's open the demo ward.
Each row is a patient, and each column is a shift. Every card is a real line from the notes, quoted word for word. Bed six is marked act now.

Here's why. On Wednesday night, a nurse wrote that this patient is allergic to penicillin. On Thursday night, she was given Augmentin, which is a penicillin. The two notes share no words, and they sit two shifts apart. The graph joins them through the penicillin family.
Click the patient, and you see everything written about her across all three shifts, with the lines behind the warning highlighted.
Click the Augmentin note, and Medicines opens right on the allergy clash.
The seven thirty summary didn't mention any of these three patients. Relayd lists them, so nothing slips through.
Under the hood, Claude reads the notes into a FalkorDB graph, every quote is checked against the original line, and each warning is a Cypher query you can inspect.
Relayd. See what last night's notes left out. All the patients and notes in this demo are made up.
